PB17-X04.name: Pentan Demon-God
PB17-X04.effect:
[Brave Condition: [Left/Right] Cost 4 or more]

This Brave doesn't exhaust, and when in Spirit condition, can't attack or block.

[When Braved on Left/Right] (When Attacks)
During this turn, give an opposing Spirit -5000 BP. Destroy the Spirit whose BP was brought to 0 by this effect. Also, when this Brave is braved with "Pentan"-named Spirits on both sides, this Spirit can't be blocked by opposing LV2/LV3 Spirits.

PB17-X02.name: The HeavenlyDemonKing Pentan -Type God-Sechs-
PB17-X02.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Magic effects.
[Six Pen Rush: 6]
While you control six or more "Pentan"-named Spirits, change this Spirit's symbols to [Yellow Core][Yellow Core][Yellow Core][Yellow Core][Yellow Core][Yellow Core] (six Yellow symbols).

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Pentan"-named Spirit attacks, during this turn, give an opposing Spirit -6000 BP. Destroy the Spirits whose BP are brought to 0 by this effect.

PB17-X05.name: The SongBirdGun Pentan Blaster
PB17-X05.effect:
[Brave Condition: Cost 5 or more]

[LV1] [Reload]
You can [Advent] onto this Spirit-condition Brave. When [Advent] onto this Brave, you can Brave this pre-Advent card to that Spirit.

[When Braved] Flash - (When Attacks)
By exhausting one "Pentan"-named Spirit you control, return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.

PB17-X01.name: The SongRoosterGodKing Gale-Pentan
PB17-X01.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Seal: Seal] (When Attacks)
You can send the [Soul Core] from this Spirit to your Life.

[Seal: When Sealed] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
You can reveal a card from your decktop. If the revealed card is "Pentan"-named, refresh this Spirit. Add the revealed card to the Hand.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
For each "Pentan"-named Spirit you control, this Spirit gains +5000 BP.
